We need to perform three searches: amide formation, sulfonamide formation, Doebner modification (aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid). Let's search each.

First amide formation.


<thought>Search for templates that break an aliphatic carboxylic acid and form an amide (C-N bond). Use functional_groups_broken "aliphatic carboxylic acid", functional_groups_formed "amide".</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
  "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
  "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>

We need result.

We didn't get output because tool not executed? The system should return. Let's wait.
